name: Provenance line
note: Pattern. Context: an emitted report whose reader must judge how much to trust it. Forces: trust requires provenance (+); the header competes with the body for attention (-); a clipped extract that looks complete is worse than no extract (-). Resolution: the first line of every emitted artifact carries its source status, byte count, and truncation flag — provenance is part of the form, not metadata about it. Contains: bounded-slice.
